description: Fetched inputs that the opt-in workflow does not store in its registry
(ci/not_stored.py, ci/inputs.sh save and complete). The packages the workflow
writes on GHCR can be read without a login, so storing a file there publishes
it. A file listed here stays out of the stored inputs; the job that needs it
downloads it from 'url' and compares it with 'sha256' and 'bytes'.
Listed: the native JARs of the bytedeco FFmpeg 4.1.3-1.5.1 preset. libavutil
inside each says 'libavutil license: nonfree and unredistributable' (built
with --enable-gpl --enable-nonfree); read with strings(1) on 2026-11-26 from
the linux-x86_64 and linux-arm64 JARs named below.
arm64: the entry repeats the pin of ../inputs.arm64.lock.json (not_stored.py
check compares them). amd64: no lock pins this JAR; the digest is the one the
fetch recorded in the development sandbox and in every amd64 run of the
workflow (status/fetch.json, actual_sha256), and its SHA-1 is the one Maven
Central publishes next to the file.
